items.title: Senator: What’s The Use Of ‘Toothless’ Health Service Commission?
items.summary: Senator Lingeshwaran asks what's the point of a "toothless" Health Service Commission (SPK) without the power to create new positions or set wages for health workers. He backs amendments to the Federal Constitution to authorise such powers for SPK. The post Senator: What’s The Use Of ‘Toothless’ Health Service Commission? appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: DAP MP Wants More Powers For Proposed Health Service Commission
items.summary: Bandar Kuching MP Kelvin Yii calls for constitutional amendments to empower a proposed Health Service Commission (SPK) to create positions and set emoluments for health workers. Such powers would be unique for SPK, compared to other service commissions. The post DAP MP Wants More Powers For Proposed Health Service Commission appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Lindung 24/7 Backlash Tests Support For Mandatory Social Insurance: Socso
items.summary: Lindung 24/7 was widely opposed because Malaysians resist sharing unforeseen risks, says Socso's deputy CEO Edmund Cheong. He believes long-term care insurance may be more acceptable because ageing is inevitable, but contributions must remain mandatory. items.title: Dzulkefly ‘Commits’ To Forming Health Service Commission Without Power To Create Positions Or Set Emoluments
items.summary: Dr Dzul commits to forming a Health Service Commission (SPK), but says it won't be able to create positions, devise a retirement scheme, or set emoluments. SPK will only have appointment or disciplinary powers under Article 144 of the Federal Constitution. items.title: Penang Hits Ambulance Response Target With Community Responders
items.summary: State exco Daniel Gooi says Penang is the only state that has achieved the national ambulance response target, due to community responders. About 58% of its Priority 1 emergency calls this year were responded to within 15 minutes, surpassing the 50% KPI. items.title: Ranau Hospital Crisis: Doctors Working 48 To 72 Straight Hours — Medical Officer
items.summary: Only 8 medical officers are running Ranau Hospital.
